candidate.version_description: This is a cover version of Bob Dylans great song "Boots of spanish leather", by Mandolin Orange. It is actually also fingerpicked in their version, but i find that its nice to strum a song to get the feel for it first. This version is with capo in 2nd which makes the chords pretty easy. Some hammer on/off effects, change of pattern or finger picking is recommended when you get the feel for the song. Hope you enjoy and as my motto in life is..."Just Play".
